description: The 3D mockup of a line's artwork on the product, as an image, and view_url: the printdash.io page for that line (checkout, the quote page or the order page) with its interactive 3D viewer already open. To show the customer the mockup, give them view_url; never give a storage or image URL. An order job is rendered by Printdash's server and cached; if it is still rendering the result says so and you call again in about 20 seconds. A cart or quote line returns the mockup checkout or the quote page stored, or else Printdash's server renders it the same way (rendering, then call again); the flat preview comes back when there is no 3D view to show. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

design.description: Which design (1 to N) on a job with several designs. Omit on a one-design job.

kind.description: cart_line (line_id from get_cart), quote_line (line_id from get_quote) or order_item (item_id from get_order).

side.description: front (default) or back, on a double-sided job.

name: get_mockup

configuration.description: The line's size, stock, sides, finishing and pages, as labelled rows.

view_url.description: The printdash.io page for this line with its 3D viewer open (checkout, the quote page or the order page, ?mockup=<line id>). The one link to give the customer.

title: Show the 3D mockup
